_comment: Column knowledge for metadata/participants.tsv, consumed by tools/csvw/generate_csvw.py. Column *sets* differ across modules (confirmed: KIP uses school-region, KIPasti/ParlaBO/ParlaTO/Stra-* use birth-region + study-level + L1/mothertongue/age-of-arrival-italy/years-in-italy instead), so this is a lookup of descriptions/datatypes by column name, not a fixed ordered list. The generator reads each module's actual header and applies whatever entries match; unmatched columns pass through undescribed rather than failing.

code.dc:description: Participant code — matches `speaker` values in vert.tsv.

gender.dc:description: Commonly F|M, not enforced as a hard constraint.

conversations.dc:description: Semicolon-separated list of conversation codes this participant appears in.
